invariants.requirement: One Texenda domain model owns audience and communication truth.
invariants.implementation: Provider contacts, analytics, CMS documents, and model output cannot independently grant communication authority.

invariants.requirement: Shared identity never creates shared permission.
invariants.implementation: A profile/endpoint match cannot activate another publication, brand, purpose, or channel.

invariants.requirement: Reachability, identity proof, consent, and preference are distinct facts.
invariants.implementation: A phone number, browser permission, or successful prior delivery is not a marketing grant.

invariants.requirement: Every proactive message and personalized placement passes the applicable central policy.
invariants.implementation: No direct provider-send endpoint; service/auth/test classes use narrow policy branches, not bypass flags.

invariants.requirement: Applicable denials dominate preferences and historical approvals.
invariants.implementation: Current opt-outs, blocks, safety holds, authority leases, and expired content are checked at final handoff.

invariants.requirement: Scope is enforced server-side and structurally in relationships.
invariants.implementation: Composite scope keys/FKs, authorized repositories, and adversarial endpoint tests; UI filtering is insufficient.

invariants.requirement: Queues wake work; business state is durable in PostgreSQL.
invariants.implementation: Dropped/duplicated jobs cannot lose an execution or create another logical effect.

invariants.requirement: Published campaigns/content/workflows are versioned and immutable.
invariants.implementation: Edits create revisions; active runs pin versions; approved changes require explicit activation/migration.

invariants.requirement: Logical occurrences, channel deliveries, attempts, and observations are different objects.
invariants.implementation: Retries do not create new communications; follow-ups consume additional interruption allowance.

invariants.requirement: Admission, deduplication, and pressure/spend reservations are atomic.
invariants.implementation: Two workers cannot independently consume the same remaining slot.

invariants.requirement: External effects are effectively-once where qualified, otherwise explicitly uncertain and reconcilable.
invariants.implementation: Unique semantic keys, stable payloads, provider idempotency, and `acceptance_unknown`; never claim universal exactly-once email.

invariants.requirement: A timeout or outage never authorizes blind provider/channel failover.
invariants.implementation: Reconcile before another effect; a block or opt-out cannot trigger escape to another channel.

invariants.requirement: Every consequential effect has a decision receipt and approved authority chain.
invariants.implementation: Record actor/configuration, revisions, eligibility evidence references, policy version, route, and timing.

invariants.requirement: AI translates intent; deterministic systems enforce truth.
invariants.implementation: Models return typed proposals; never direct SQL, provider credentials, consent grants, or policy override.

invariants.requirement: Recipient trust outranks communication volume.
invariants.implementation: Expire stale work; suppress duplicates; enforce caps; never flush a deferred backlog in a burst.

invariants.requirement: Imports/replays do not silently activate automations or weaken denials.
invariants.implementation: Default `trigger_mode=historical`; negative evidence wins until an explicit valid reconsent.

invariants.requirement: Successful opt-out acknowledgment means the restriction is durably recorded and applied.
invariants.implementation: No success response before authoritative mutation and the recovery safety evidence are durable.

invariants.requirement: Restore/recovery cannot silently revive prior permissions or repeat uncertain effects.
invariants.implementation: Independent safety journal, deployment send gate, reconciliation, and new execution epoch before resuming.

invariants.requirement: Publication migration has one active sending authority for each scoped function/cohort.
invariants.implementation: A Texenda worker checks an authority lease; Kit-side controls must be verified, not assumed enforceable by Texenda.

invariants.requirement: Test/development environments cannot reach real recipients through production transport.
invariants.implementation: No production credentials, egress controls, fake providers/Mailpit; `NODE_ENV` alone is not a safety boundary.

invariants.requirement: Audit immutability is not indefinite retention of personal data.
invariants.implementation: Append corrections; separate erasable PII; lawful retention/erasure process preserves only justified evidence.

invariants.requirement: No automatic cross-brand marketing action derives from another brand's behavior.
invariants.implementation: Shared coordination may delay a send, but cannot supply missing permission, targeting authority, or disclosure.

invariants.requirement: Conversation is not authoritative product state.
invariants.implementation: Durable object recovery

invariants.requirement: All interaction surfaces share command/policy contracts.
invariants.implementation: No parallel mutations

invariants.requirement: Exact immutable approval and bounded consequences.
invariants.implementation: Stale approval rejection

invariants.requirement: Agent actions use attributable bounded delegation.
invariants.implementation: Revocation and scope tests

invariants.requirement: Agent legibility does not confer authority.
invariants.implementation: Inspect/DOM tests

invariants.requirement: Core remains usable without AI/voice/realtime.
invariants.implementation: Degradation tests

invariants.requirement: Memory cannot become policy implicitly.
invariants.implementation: Instruction promotion tests

invariants.requirement: Development harness does not grant production authority.
invariants.implementation: Harness/runtime isolation
